gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-naskh-arabi: Almendra Display opens with ornate, literary flourish, its letters never pinching shut. Noto Naskh Arabic follows, a refined serif with lightly engraved modest contrast and a very tall x-height.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-nastaliq-ur: Ornate and bookish up top, dignified below. Almendra Display carries the flourish with low contrast, while Noto Nastaliq Urdu keeps a tight vertical rhythm and gentle modulation for steady text.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-rashi-hebre: Storybook flourish meets a quiet, bookish body. Almendra Display has low contrast and open letters, and Noto Rashi Hebrew gives lightly modulated strokes, so a slightly generous body size lets its short ascenders breathe.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary hand with low contrast and a pronounced x-height over Noto Serif Ahom. Its text feels traditional and dignified.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-armen: Authoritative and traditional, Noto Serif Armenian has big open counters and a mild, approachable stroke contrast beneath the ornament. Almendra Display handles the flourish; the body does the steady talking.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-balin: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters with low contrast and a pronounced x-height to the top of the page. And Noto Serif Balinese settles beneath it as an editorial classic serif, with visible thick-thin variation and lowercase of great vertical presence.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-benga: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with low contrast. Noto Serif Bengali, refined and editorial with slightly thinner hairlines, can take a comfortable body size, since its thick band of lowercase carries well.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-devan: Classic and literary, this serif body has slightly thinner curves on its rounded tops and a big lowercase. Noto Serif Devanagari would read smoothly over many lines, with Almendra Display's ornate, low-contrast flourish above.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-dives: Noto Serif Dives Akuru is a refined serif with short capitals. Its strongest quality is soft contrast in every curve, set against Almendra Display, whose ornate, literary letters never pinch shut.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-dogra: Noto Serif Dogra reads bookish and classic, its capitals only slightly taller than the lowercase. Almendra Display does ornate, literary flourish with low contrast best, while the serif body offers mild stress that keeps every stroke solid.
